expectations.text: At 200% zoom on a 1280px window (CSS viewport 640px, 1rem = 32px), the body, small, caption and label font-size tokens compute to exactly twice their size at 100% zoom
At 200% zoom on a 1280px window, every heading and hero font-size token computes to at least 1.6 times its size at 100% zoom
expectations.evidence: Playwright 2x@640/@1280 ratios: hero 1.584, h1 1.663, h2 1.711, h3 1.765, h4 1.880; hero below 1.6 (--font-size-hero 57.04px -> 90.37px).

expectations.text: Adjacent heading tokens (hero, h1, h2, h3, h4) differ by at least 1.15 times at both a 360px and a 1440px viewport at 100% zoom
tokens.css derives vertical spacing tokens from the body line (body size times body line-height), not from a fixed px value
expectations.evidence: Spacing is a fixed rem scale (--space-3xs: 0.25rem ... --space-2xl: 4rem, "4px base"), em flow tokens (--flow-space: 1em) and fluid clamp() sections; nothing references body size x line-height.

expectations.text: tokens.css gives the uppercase label token letter-spacing of at least 0.05em and the hero token zero or negative letter-spacing
